((('A projector throws the incoming picture into ray-marched fog.
Thin layers of smoke each catch the whole picture and travel down the beam on the beat. A shadow map cuts out the amphora.', 'The incoming picture is the light behind a venetian blind: its colours ride the shafts through ray-marched fog.
The slats open and close over two bars. A shadow map cuts out the gramophone.', 'No beam here: five thin planes of red light slice the fog, and each shows a cross-section of the drifting smoke.
Kick and snare choose which planes flare. The objects are only a black skyline.', "The incoming picture is the lamp's light: one cone, ray-marched through fine smoke, landing on an astrolabe and a stack of solids.
The kick makes the smoke thicker. A shadow map cuts the objects' shadows out of the cone.", 'Seen from straight above: a projector throws the incoming picture across the carpet at a raking angle.
Its beam streaks the ray-marched fog. A shadow map gives the pierced stone and the cone their long shadows.', "A projector high on the left throws the incoming picture across a big dark floor, through ray-marched fog.
Kick and snare strike the ceiling tubes. A shadow map cuts the objects' shadows out of the picture.", 'No projector: five bare fluorescent tubes are line lights in thin fog, each mirrored in the floor by one reflected ray.
Kick and snare choose which tubes strike. They stutter like a ballast catching, then hold bright.', "The same fog and light, reduced to pure black and white dots by an ordered dither.
A spoked wheel turns in front of the lamp on the beat. The bust's shadow is a solid shape in the fog.", 'The projector lights the room with the negative of the incoming picture.
The cage turns in the beam and a shadow map throws its shadow on the wall. A snare makes the lamp brighter.', "No projector: eight ceiling tubes light the fog as line lights, sampled 12 times along each pixel's ray.
A pulse of light runs down the row toward the camera every two beats. Kick and snare strike single tubes.", "A hidden projector beside the floor tube throws the incoming picture, and the looped ribbon's shadow, up the wall.
Kick and snare strike the tube, and the tube and the picture flicker together.")) if op('inp')['on'] else (('A projector shines through a stencil of these words into ray-marched fog.
Thin layers of smoke catch the image and travel down the beam on the beat. A snare makes it brighter.', "Volumetric light: one shader steps 64 times through fog along each pixel's ray and asks if light reaches that point.
Here the mask is a venetian blind. The slats open and close over two bars. A shadow map cuts out the gramophone.", 'No beam here: five thin planes of red light slice the fog, and each shows a cross-section of the drifting smoke.
Kick and snare choose which planes flare. The objects are only a black skyline.', "One cone of warm light, ray-marched through fine smoke over an astrolabe and a stack of solids.
The kick makes the smoke thicker. A shadow map cuts the objects' shadows out of the cone.", 'Seen from straight above: a projector throws these tiled words across the carpet at a raking angle.
Rows slide against each other on the beat. A shadow map gives the pierced stone and the cone their long shadows.', "The projector's mask is a printed grid: its ruled lines and filled boxes become planes of blue light in the fog.
Kick and snare strike the ceiling tubes. Each new section of the song fills different boxes.", 'No projector: five bare fluorescent tubes are line lights in thin fog, each mirrored in the floor by one reflected ray.
Kick and snare choose which tubes strike. They stutter like a ballast catching, then hold bright.', "The same fog and light, reduced to pure black and white dots by an ordered dither.
A spoked wheel turns in front of the lamp on the beat. The bust's shadow is a solid shape in the fog.", 'The mask is inverted: the projector lights the whole room and these words are its shadows.
The cage turns in the beam and a shadow map throws its shadow on the wall. A snare makes the lamp brighter.', "No projector: eight ceiling tubes light the fog as line lights, sampled 12 times along each pixel's ray.
A pulse of light runs down the row toward the camera every two beats. Kick and snare strike single tubes.", "One fluorescent tube lies on the carpet. A hidden lamp beside it throws the looped ribbon's shadow up the wall.
Kick and snare strike the tube, and the tube and its light flicker together.")))[int(parent().par.Take)%11] if parent().par.Describe else ''
